promptPrefix: High fashion editorial photograph, fashion week or luxury magazine quality —
promptSuffix: Every element of the frame is considered: the garments are the protagonist, the lighting deliberate and sculptural.
variantDirectives: Wide runway frame, the figures small within the show space:
Full-length editorial frame, movement and posture carry the mood:
Tight beauty close-up, faces fill the frame:
One hard light on a bare set, stark and minimal:
The set and architecture dominate the frame, the figures secondary:
Full-length lookbook frame, every detail of the garments visible:

translations.clothes vs. body: clothes as architecture for the body beneath
translations.dressed vs. undone: dressed to a point then deliberately undone
translations.camera vs. mirror: performing for the camera or only for the mirror
translations.season vs. off-season: in season and already moving toward what comes next
translations.designer vs. street: designer language spoken back in street terms
translations.front row vs. backstage: the front row watching what backstage already knows
translations.beauty vs. bizarre: beauty pushed one degree past into the bizarre
translations.high fashion vs. wearable: high fashion translated into something almost wearable
translations.styled vs. raw: styled to the edge of raw
translations.model vs. character: the model dissolving into the character
translations.motion vs. pose: motion caught and held as pose
translations.haute couture vs. ready-to-wear: the couture ideal against ready-to-wear reality
translations.collection vs. single look: the collection distilled into one single look
translations.luxury vs. accessible: luxury pressed against what is actually accessible
translations.body vs. silhouette: the body against the silhouette it makes
translations.moment vs. campaign: the unrepeatable moment against the manufactured campaign
